facts.claim: Fallout 4 is Steam app 377160 and the Creation Kit is Steam app 1946160; both install into the same game folder.

facts.claim: Runtime lines: Old-Gen up to 1.10.163, Next-Gen 1.10.980-1.10.984, Anniversary Edition 1.11.x. Address Library bins exist for 1.10.130-1.10.163, 1.10.980-1.10.984 and 1.11.137-1.11.240.
facts.source: installed Address Library bins (version-*.bin) give the version lines; the generation names are community usage on the F4SE and Address Library pages

facts.claim: F4SE ships f4se_loader.exe and f4se_<major>_<minor>_<build>.dll named after the runtime it supports; their version resource reads 0.A.B.C for F4SE A.B.C.
F4SE 0.7.9 is installed with f4se_1_11_240.dll matching the runtime; its source ships as src/f4se-0.7.9.tar.gz in the game folder.
The Address Library database is Data/F4SE/Plugins/version-<a>-<b>-<c>-<d>.bin, one file per runtime; the 1.11.240.0 file is present.

Creation Kit 1.11.246.0 installs into the game folder with Papyrus Compiler/PapyrusCompiler.exe 2.8.0.4, Tools/Archive2/Archive2.exe 1.1.0.5, Tools/LipGen/LipGenerator/LipGenerator.exe 1.0.0.1, Tools/Audio/xwmaencode.exe 9.28.1876.0, LIPFuzer and Elric. It is newer than the 1.11.240 runtime.
facts.source: version resources of the listed executables

facts.claim: Official Papyrus sources ship as Data/Scripts/Source/Base/Base.zip (2422 .psc are also loose in Base) and DLC01.zip-DLC06.zip in their DLC folders; the compiler flags file is Base/Institute_Papyrus_Flags.flg.
A BA2 header is 24 bytes: magic BTDX, u32 version, 4-char type GNRL or DX10, u32 file count, u64 name-table offset. Every installed archive parses with this layout.
facts.source: header census of every Data/*.ba2 on this install (0 errors)

facts.claim: Installed archives use versions 1, 7 and 8: 643 BA2 = v1 GNRL 150, v1 DX10 99, v7 GNRL 1, v7 DX10 11, v8 GNRL 198, v8 DX10 184.
Fallout4 - Misc.ba2 is v8 GNRL with 8570 files (base .pex), Fallout4 - Materials.ba2 v8 GNRL with 6899 files, Fallout4 - TexturesPatch.ba2 v8 DX10 with 7 files (smallest DX10 sample).
facts.source: BA2 headers of the named archives
